Option 1: The PLACEHOLDER can be replaced with:
```
item.id
```
This would result in different behavior because each todo's label would show its numeric ID (for example "1700000000000") and not the text the user typed.

Option 2: The PLACEHOLDER can be replaced with:
```
item.title.slice(1)
```
This would result in different behavior because the first character of every title would be dropped. "Buy milk" would show as "uy milk", and a one-character todo would show as an empty label.

Option 3: The PLACEHOLDER can be replaced with:
```
item.title.toUpperCase()
```
This would result in different behavior because every todo label would be shown in capital letters ("BUY MILK" and not "Buy milk"). Any test that checks the text of a todo after adding or editing it would fail.

DONE.
